rationale.consistency: Reuses gitindex.IndexGitRepo and index.Options.Flags, but list/remove use a bare -index with no default while sync defaults to ~/.zoekt; unguarded syscall.Flock ignores the repo's unix/other build-tag convention.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles duplicate names, missing roots, no roots, unmatched remove args, .git-file worktrees and bare repos; passing the same root twice errors as a duplicate, multi-repo shards are deleted wholesale, unreadable shards are silently skipped.
rationale.scope: Delivers the command, subcommands, lock and gitindex name fix; adds an unrequested explicit 'sync' subcommand and ~100 lines of up-to-date detection beyond the preview requirement.
rationale.readability: Clear file split and flow; matchRecord is a tangle of abs/source comparisons, recordsFromShards juggles three parallel structures, and isRepository carries spec-style '(a)/(b)' comments.
rationale.robustness: Per-repo errors are collected and reported; but inventory is read before the lock is taken, repositoryUpToDate swallows open/branch errors as 'not up to date', errors are printed twice, and Flock is not portable.
rationale.maintainability: repositoryUpToDate re-implements gitindex branch expansion and IncrementalSkipIndexing, coupling preview to library internals; NameFromGitConfig inverts the default so any unlisted direct caller silently changes behaviour.
